INSERT INTO local_credentials (user_id, password_hash, totp_secret_enc)
         VALUES ($1, $2, $3)
         ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE
            SET password_hash = EXCLUDED.password_hash,
                totp_secret_enc = EXCLUDED.totp_secret_enc,
                totp_last_step = NULL,
                failed_attempts = 0,
                locked_until = NULL,
                password_changed_at = now()
